title: Taking Away | KG Maths for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Learn to take away with balloons, ducks and mangoes. Count what is left, meet the take away sign, then try a quick quiz with Takhti. For KG children (ages 4 to 5).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/kg-maths-taking-away-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Hello
0:11 Balloons
0:32 Ducks swim away
0:49 Cross out
1:06 Quiz
1:58 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
